stage: Cached crop-boundary mechanism prerequisite with conditional fixed fusion pilot
question: Do source boxes exactly clipped at INTERNAL crop boundaries supply useful one-sided coordinate constraints, rather than noisy point estimates, in the existing multi-view candidate menu?
difference: Candidate29 selected separate sides using geometry heads without treating a clipped coordinate as an inequality. Candidate31 estimated cross-view error moments. Candidate21/22 censoring concerns NMS selection, not spatial crop truncation. Preserve all those STOPs. No image, feature or label parameter is retuned.
sample: Exactly original candidate18 first64 headheldout detector-training images, existing five native action slots0..4 and candidate12 windows. Original normalized source-view onehot recovered exactly with frozen templates. No fit split, image decoding, detector forwards or new labels for training. This is a repeated diagnostic sample.
censor_flags: An available native action is left/top censored only if its x1/y1 equals its source window's x1/y1 EXACTLY and that window edge is strictly inside the image. Right/bottom analog at x2/y2 with boundary strictly below image width/height. Never flag an original-image boundary or global view. Do not use a distance tolerance, GT, score, owner or native logits to set flags.
active: Original calibrated confidence>=.05, at least2 available native slots, at least1 spatial censor flag. No synthetic vote slot participates. All other original rows preserve frozen regret exactly in every arm.
mechanism_labels: Compute frozen regret class-aware greedy GT matching atconfidence.05/IoU.5 over ALL originalrows/allGT BEFORE active filtering. Each matchedGT supplies one owner's four true coordinates. GT size groups at640 reference. For each flagged side compare the GT edge to the crop bound: left/top target<=bound, right/bottom target>=bound. Report weak inequality validity and strict actual extension, counts and independent affected GT/image coverage.
fail_mechanism: STOP_THIS_EXACT_CROP_CENSORING_RECIPE before AP evaluation if any mechanism gate fails. No expanding tolerance, lowering association cutoff, changing object-size group or increasing subset after results. Sparse signal does not disprove approximate crop effects.

fixed_arms_if_mechanism_passes.point: On exactly active rows, equal-weight whole-box mean of all available native slots.
fixed_arms_if_mechanism_passes.drop_whole: Same rows, equal-weight whole-box mean only native slots with NO censored side; none means keep regret.
fixed_arms_if_mechanism_passes.drop_side: Same rows, each side equal-weight mean over available uncensored coordinates; if none keep that regret side. Invalid extent reverts entire row to regret.
fixed_arms_if_mechanism_passes.one_sided: Same rows, each side minimizes sum uncensored(z-coordinate)^2 plus censored hinge^2. Left/top hinge=max(0,z-bound), right/bottom hinge=max(0,bound-z). If no uncensored values, choose regret side projected into the common feasible halfline. Otherwise enumerate active-set stationary candidates and crop bound breakpoints and take minimum objective, ties closest regret then smaller coordinate. Invalid extent reverts entire row.

deployment_invariants: Native boxes/valid/source/windows are sole inputs to all candidate arms. All scores/classes/count/order unchanged. No rescore, new NMS, added boxes, fitting, GT-driven routing or choice of reported best arm. Only nominal unweighted observations; no new confidence weighting.
evaluation_if_passes: COCO-style AP50:95/max500 at640reference, all/tiny/small_all plus pooled fixedFPPI10 recall on all64 frames. Full rematching, original diagnostic ignore-filtered query pool. Not official VisDroneAP. No efficacy from own-GT mean edge errors or mechanism inequalities.
pass_action: Only authorize separately preregistered train-scene bootstrap/fresh-scene and annotation-free official replay feasibility plus measured runtime; a no-fit improvement has no training-seed replication. Need explicit nearest crop-truncation/partial-observation fusion comparisons before innovation.
fail_efficacy: STOP_THIS_ONE_SIDED_EQUAL_WEIGHT_CROP_FUSION_RECIPE, without score, weight, tolerance, support policy, active mask or arm substitution to rescue.
prior_boundary: SAHI already uses overlapping sliced inference and NMS. SAHI/other tile-processing code may merge partial boxes via IoS/union, which is different from a full-box point average but is prior boundary handling. Side-based localization is established in SABL/BorderDet. Censored regression and squared hinge constraints are established statistics/optimization, not innovation by themselves.
limits: Exact clipping misses near-boundary biases and objects never associated by the originalIoU.5menu. A crop-touching prediction can instead be an unrelated or badly localized box. Inequalities from several views need not be jointly correct; dropping sides can lose evidence. Detector saw train scenes and diagnostic ignores are inherited.
